name: knowledge-base-command-center
description: Configurable visual knowledge index, note creator, collections, and smart queues for Obsidian.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.test: node --import tsx --import ./tests/support/register.mjs --test tests/model.test.ts tests/main.test.ts tests/view.test.ts tests/mobile-dom.test.ts tests/bases-view.test.ts tests/quick-entry.test.ts tests/attachment.test.ts tests/store-merge.test.ts tests/taxonomy-health.test.ts tests/portfolio.test.ts
scripts.review: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run verify-community && npm run verify-release
